Hymn 242: Praise God, from Whom All Blessings Flow
Time Signature: 4/4

Composer: Louis Bourgeois

This is hymn number 242 titled "Praise God, from Whom All Blessings Flow" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Louis Bourgeois and the lyrics were written by Thomas Ken.
